department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
benefit: You get a bank loan card for farming costs, post-harvest costs, home needs and farm upkeep. The Government of India gives 2% interest help and 3% more if you repay on time. So the loan can cost you only 4% a year. The card is valid for 5 years. Up to Rs 1.60 lakh, the crop itself is the security.

other: Owner farmers, alone or jointly, can apply.
Tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers can apply.
Self Help Groups or Joint Liability Groups of farmers can apply.
If you are a senior citizen, you need a co-borrower who is your legal heir.

documents: ID proof (driving licence, Aadhaar, voter ID or passport)
Land proof certified by revenue officers
Security papers for loans above Rs 1.60 lakh or Rs 3 lakh
how_to_apply: Go to the website of the bank you choose. Pick Kisan Credit Card and click Apply. Fill the form and submit. You get a reference number. If you are eligible, the bank will contact you in 3 to 4 working days.
where_to_apply: Your bank (online on the bank's website)

evidence.quote: The Government of India provides interest subvention of 2% and Prompt Repayment Incentive of 3% to the farmers, thus making the credit available at a very subsidized rate of 4% per annum.
